thought.text: While Keycloak starts, let me kick off the frontend `npm i` in the background.

reasoning_content:
Keycloak is starting up. Let's wait for it to be ready. In the meantime, I can run `npm i` in the frontend in parallel. Actually, let me first check whether the import file issue has occurred — the container is still running, so it hasn't crashed. However, if you specify a non-existent file to KEYCLOAK_IMPORT, it should fail... In Keycloak 26, if KEYCLOAK_IMPORT points to a non-existent file, the container will crash. It's still "Up", so let's see how it goes. Actually, since it's still in the middle of starting up, I'll wait a bit longer.

I'll run `npm i` in the frontend in the background, and in the meantime I'll poll the Keycloak health check.

action.command:
cd /workspace/src/Frontend/Strassennamen && nohup npm i > /tmp/npm-install.log 2>&1 &
echo "npm i started in background"
